western_bluebird.recommendation: Provisional neutral/downward-look source intake with neutral still fallback.
western_bluebird.identity: Blue head/throat/wings/tail, rusty breast/upper-back area and pale lower belly remain recognizable as the intended adult male Western Bluebird. Exact coastal form and lighting/color fidelity remain provisional.
western_bluebird.pose: Alternate lowers the head/bill as a downward inspection, with recognizable individual appearance. It is a crisp200ms pose change, not a feeding/preen interaction.
western_bluebird.styleBrightness: Blue/rust/white regions remain clear at60world-pixel width. Fine feather redraw is visible enlarged but no conspicuous body-color flash or gross stance jump is evident in the actual-size source comparison.
western_bluebird.contact: Recomputed coarse foot centroid changes0.441world units with unchanged lowest mask boundary. Common declared contacts remain alpha-positive; actual branch grip/contact is unapproved.
western_bluebird.scale: 60world-pixel neutral width;59.09alternate width at the same density/export scale.
western_bluebird.remaining: Owner and actual yard/support review; no movement/insect-catch behavior or physical scale certified.

spotted_towhee.recommendation: Provisional neutral/upward-look source intake with neutral still fallback.
spotted_towhee.identity: Dark hood/upperparts, rufous flanks, white belly, organized white wing/back spots and red-eye intent remain readable as the intended adult male towhee. Exact megalonyx/local-form identification is not independently certified.
spotted_towhee.pose: Head/bill look upward is clear at66world-pixel width. Pose and plumage remain coherent across the brief200ms switch.
spotted_towhee.styleBrightness: White spots are intentionally grouped diagnostic markings on the dark wing/back, not automatically random pale noise. Dark plumage is retained rather than judged against a universal brightness minimum. No distracting global flash appears in normal-size source views.
spotted_towhee.contact: Coarse centroid change0.105world units and unchanged lowest mask boundary. No gross toe translation is apparent in the source pair; physical ground support remains unapproved.
spotted_towhee.scale: 66neutral/64.31alternate world-pixel width, with one density and no per-pose fit.
spotted_towhee.remaining: Owner/yard validation and future movement/double-scratch/peck binding remain separate.

dark_eyed_junco.recommendation: Retain as rest/eyelid source studies only. packetBindingReady=false and awakeIdleAvailable=false are appropriate. Do not intake as an awake idle/blink resident.
dark_eyed_junco.identity: Dark hood, warm brown back, buff sides, white belly, pink bill/legs and pale outer tail edge support the requested Oregon-type male intent. Exact form/sex remains provisional.
dark_eyed_junco.eyeFinding: Both native/registered eye crops show narrow or closed lids. The requested neutral is not demonstrably open-eyed. Distinct raster hashes or a100ms alternate cannot establish an open→closed→open blink.
dark_eyed_junco.poseUsefulness: A closed-eyed still may be useful in an explicitly labeled resting context. Neither still is a substitute for the missing awake neutral or completed blink.
dark_eyed_junco.styleContact: Body color groups are legible at52world-pixel width. Coarse centroid change0.371world units and constant lower boundary are small; pink feet are visible. Source registration is not biological contact approval.
dark_eyed_junco.filenameCaveat: Technical names neutral/blink in retained file IDs remain for immutable provenance; semantic classification is rest/eyelid study.
dark_eyed_junco.missing: Awake neutral and a verified functional blink remain missing. No new generation is queued by this review.

california_quail.recommendation: Use the useful neutral PNG/static manifest as first provisional review intake. Retain paired look candidly as a posture/stance study; do not automatically activate it as a planted idle loop.
california_quail.identity: Forward comma-like crest, black face with white borders, gray breast, brown wing and ordered scaled/chestnut belly remain recognizable as the intended adult male California Quail. Fine gamebird toe/anatomical and local-form fidelity remain unapproved.
california_quail.styleBrightness: The belly scallops/scales and wing markings are structured species pattern, not arbitrary pale specks. Gray/brown/cream fields remain readable at88world-pixel neutral width; no generic brightness/palette correction is justified solely by these markings.
california_quail.visiblePairIssue: The look is a real more-upright head/body posture, with a noticeably narrower body silhouette and changed foot/leg shapes and stance. Fixed-canvas world-size and enlarged foot-ROI comparisons make this a visible posture/stance redraw rather than merely a failed numeric threshold. In a short repeated idle it can read as a stance pop or sliding without intervening weight-shift motion.
california_quail.contactEvidence: Coarse foot-mask centroid shifts3.813world units while the lowest boundary stays fixed. A centroid is not rigid-foot tracking; this metric supports the visible redraw concern but does not by itself prove3.813units of physical sliding.
california_quail.scale: 88neutral versus78.15alternate world-pixel width, with height86.77→91.08. One common density/export is retained, so no per-frame fit is claimed; the source posture itself changes.
california_quail.remaining: Actual yard ground/stance review should decide whether the pair is usable or needs a dedicated transition. Neutral still is a practical handoff now; no art reroll requested after generation stop.
california_quail.stillFirstNotArtDiscard: Both drawings remain retained source evidence. Preference for the still is scoped to immediate intake, not rejection of the species identity or all possible uses of the look.

relativeScaleAndAnatomy.interpretation: The proposed bluebird/towhee/junco/quail size order is visually reasonable within this packet. Bounding-box width is not independently calibrated biological bill-to-tail length.
relativeScaleAndAnatomy.obviousDefects: No conspicuous extra limb or detached part is visible in the inspected source views. Junco eye-state failure and Quail stance change remain material use-specific limitations.
relativeScaleAndAnatomy.contactScope: Same alpha-positive marker pixels only establish a technical registration condition. Coarse mask centroids/lowest rows do not certify toe correspondence, ground force, branch grip or depth/occlusion.
relativeScaleAndAnatomy.earlierNuttallHold: Earlier Nuttall tail-plane/support defect and binding hold remain unchanged; no other batch files were edited.
